title: St. Petersburg Lodge No. 139
teaser: Visiting as a Brother from Palmetto Lodge No. 19.
body: On October 20, 2026 I visited St. Petersburg Lodge No. 139 in St. Petersburg, Florida, as a visiting Brother from Palmetto Lodge No. 19, and joined the Brethren for dinner and their meeting.

title: International Temple, Supreme Assembly, Order of the Rainbow for Girls
teaser: Visiting Rainbow’s international headquarters on the way home from Supreme Session in Tucson.
body: On the drive home from the Supreme Session in Tucson, Arizona (held at El Conquistador Tucson, A Hilton Resort), we stopped in McAlester to visit the International Temple, Supreme Assembly, Order of the Rainbow for Girls.

The Order of the Rainbow for Girls was founded in McAlester on April 6, 1922, by Rev. W. Mark Sexson. The temple was built in 1950–1951 as the Order’s international headquarters and was listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 2013.
